notes.title: Axom: Conquest Demo Patch 0.8.0.2
notes.content: [p][i]Welcome to Axom: Conquest's biggest patch yet! This patch combines all the feedback I have received over the time the demo has been available and I've really pushed to make this the best possible tower defence game I can.[/i][/p][p][i]I can't wait to get some more feedback and keep progressing toward the release![/i][/p][p][i]Axom will be ours![/i][/p][p][/p][h3][b]Featured Changes[/b][/h3][p][b]Gameplay[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]New Tower: Alien Cannon[/b] - Shoots a projectile that explodes into a sphere which damages enemies over time and slows their attack speed.[/p][/*][*][p][b]New Tower: Mortar[/b] - Shoots a long range projectile that moves slow and explodes in an area.[/p][/*][*][p][b]New Tower: Snowballer[/b] - Shoots a projectile that deals cold damage.[/p][/*][*][p]Advanced and Experimental upgrade rarities have had their chance of appearing doubled (Meaning you will see them much more often than before).[/p][/*][*][p]The trader will now appear every 2 waves (Up from 3).[/p][/*][*][p]You can now “Lock” Upgrades in the trader (So if you see something you like but cannot afford it yet).[/p][/*][*][p]Later wave upgrades and structures now appear twice as early, for example (wave 5 instead of 10).[/p][/*][*][p]Research Tree has been reworked slightly and some upgrades have been replaced.[/p][/*][*][p]Towers placed on high-ground now have 30% increased range and damage, and there is an indicator to show this.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]New System (Capsules)[/b][/p][list][*][p]Capsules are a new thing can be found or bought in the trader. They act as one time use consumables and have various instant effects for example (Double Capsule - Select a Tower or Hazard, it duplicates to a nearby location).[/p][/*][*][p]14 New capsules added (Play and find them all!).[/p][/*][*][p]Certain Towers now have new variants, for example (Double-Flak is upgraded from Flak-Gun) These come in the form of capsules.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]New System (Tile modifiers)[/b][/p][list][*][p]Each tile of the map can now have different tile types (Which come from capsules or upgrades) and give various effects both positive and negative.[/p][/*][*][p]There is currently 3 tile types with plans to add a lot more.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Research Structures Overhauled[/b][/p][list][*][p]Previously research structures took up the same slot as towers and hazards. Now they act as a separate upgrade.[/p][/*][*][p]You get to choose 1 research structure on wave 5 and 15.[/p][/*][*][p]Each research structure must be built and provides a passive ability along with new active abilities which have wave cooldowns.[/p][/*][*][p]There are currently 5 research structures to be found in the Demo.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3][b]Enemies[/b][/h3][list][*][p]New enemy: Hexxer - a humanoid alien that casts disabling hexxes, acts as the boss for the Demo.[/p][/*][*][p]New enemy types will now appear every 5 waves (Previously 10). This means every boss wave now contains a new enemy type.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3][b]New Upgrades[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Dozens of new upgrades to find and collect.[/p][/*][*][p]New nexus types to discover.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3][b]Visuals[/b][/h3][list][*][p]When placing Refineries you now get a preview of how it will affect enemy paths and the preview will now snap to resource nodes.[/p][/*][*][p]Build grid has had it’s visuals overhauled.[/p][/*][*][p]Tower range increase per level is now shown as an expanding circle when hovering the upgrade button for that tower.[/p][/*][*][p]New visuals for the initial Nexus landing sequence.[/p][/*][*][p]New textures and visuals for both the desert and snow biomes.[/p][/*][*][p]Cliff models have been updated.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3][b]Audio[/b][/h3][list][*][p]New combat music track.[/p][/*][*][p]There is a new audio log when clicking on a resource cache for the first time.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3][b]User Interface[/b][/h3][list][*][p]The entire User interface have been overhauled.[/p][/*][*][p]New visuals for all menus and buttons.[/p][/*][*][p]The build menu no longer exists, instead replaced with a dedicated bar at the bottom of the screen.[/p][/*][*][p]New bar on the left side of the screen for the new consumable and research ability system.[/p][/*][*][p]The menu to look at current upgrades has been moved to the right side of the screen.[/p][/*][*][p]The trader menu is now no longer a completely separate screen and is built into the main interface.[/p][/*][*][p]When hovering the upgrade button in the selected building panel, you now get a preview of all the stat changes that will occur when upgrading.[/p][/*][*][p]Tooltips for all upgrades now display their type, tier and level.[/p][/*][*][p]New accessibility option to change the UI colour.[/p][/*][*][p]The Upgrades menu in the main menu has been overhauled and renamed, it is now called the Axom Codex and contains much more information like, nexus types, enemies encountered etc.[/p][/*][*][p]Dialogue pop-ups now appear in the top corner of the screen and no longer interrupt gameplay, they can be closed at any time.[/p][/*][*][p]When any tooltip appears (Or hovered in the trader) there will now be an additional tooltip to explain any keyworded mechanics (Like Void for example).[/p][/*][*][p]New icons for all stats (These will appear any time a stat appears in a tooltip).[/p][/*][*][p]Research Tree upgrades now all have flavour text when clicking on them.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h2][b]Minor Changes[/b][/h2][h3][b]Gameplay[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Trader prices have been adjusted, now they are slightly cheaper as you progress to higher waves but will stay the same at lower waves.[/p][/*][*][p]The Q and E keys can now be used to rotate the camera, in addition to the existing buttons.[/p][/*][*][p]The Demo now has a wave cap of 20.[/p][/*][*][p]Resource caches will now drop 1 free capsule in addition to the random upgrade.[/p][/*][*][p]Alien-Ruins now drop 1 capsule and 1 alien upgrade (Previously 2 alien upgrades).[/p][/*][*][p]New accessibility option to slow down gameplay when hovering combat abilities (To give you a chance to read them).[/p][/*][*][p]Infected-Ground now spreads at the end of every other wave, previously it was every wave. And there is now text that appears making this more clear.[/p][/*][*][p]Structures sold the same wave they are built now sell for 90% of their build value.[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Enemies[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Ranged enemies have had their range reduced and their minimum range increased (This means they will attack walls sooner, rather than wait to attack the structures behind).[/p][/*][*][p]Swarmers - Now move slightly slower and have more health.[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Structure Changes[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Scouting Beacon upgrade cost reduced by 25%.[/p][/*][*][p]Booster Tower now always shows the range it affects other structures.[/p][/*][*][p]Tower range increase per level increased to 110%, from 105%.[/p][/*][*][p]Hazards can no longer be placed on high-ground (This was redundant anyway).[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Upgrade Changes[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Space Stilts - Now provides 20% increased range on high ground, down from 25%.[/p][/*][*][p]All Basic upgrades now have more basic names to distinguish themselves from the more advanced upgrades.[/p][/*][*][p]Box-O-Scrap - Removed and replaced with a new capsule.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3][b]Visual[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Icons when Structures are destroyed are now more eye-catching.[/p][/*][*][p]Icons for upgrades and capsules when they drop are now more eye-catching.[/p][/*][*][p]On the far upper cliff level there is now spiky rocks to indicate this area is unbuildable.[/p][/*][*][p]New effect when selling structures.[/p][/*][*][p]Various particle and visual effects have been tweaked for readability or quality.[/p][/*][*][p]Maximum zoom out distance has been increased slightly.[/p][/*][*][p]The map now contains slightly more dense scenery.[/p][/*][*][p]The main menu background art and animations have been updated (Planet Axom has new effects).[/p][/*][*][p]Outline effect has been reworked slightly.[/p][/*][*][p]Health bars for both structures and enemies now scale based on screen size (So they will always appear uniform).[/p][/*][*][p]New explosion effects.[/p][/*][*][p]Structure health bars now wiggle and shake slightly when the structure is actively taking damage.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3][b]Audio[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Research Structures now make unique sounds when built and clicked on.[/p][/*][*][p]Hints have a new sound when appearing.[/p][/*][*][p]New sounds when collecting alien or none alien upgrades.[/p][/*][*][p]New sound effects for certain upgrades and effects.[/p][/*][*][p]New explosions sounds.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3][b]User Interface[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Controls page in settings updated with some more hotkeys (Keybindings still WIP).[/p][/*][*][p]Upgrade button in the selected building panel now shows stat multipliers when upgrading in the button.[/p][/*][*][p]All stats in the building panel are now colour coded.[/p][/*][*][p]Tower range is now a viewable stat in the building panel.[/p][/*][*][p]When upgrades appear after completing a wave or finding blueprints there is now text and an icon showing exactly what type of upgrade it is. (Choose a basic upgrade, Choose an alien upgrade etc).[/p][/*][*][p]Next wave indicator at the top of the screen now shows the total waves (5/20 instead of 5).[/p][/*][*][p]The cursor now flashes more prominently when the Ion-Cannon is ready to fire.[/p][/*][*][p]Structure build costs are now listed in the actual buttons, in addition to their tooltips.[/p][/*][*][p]New tooltips when hovering over currencies.[/p][/*][*][p]When structures are selected for construction they now have a subtle animation to show this.[/p][/*][*][p]Settings menu now has separate menus for gameplay and accessability.[/p][/*][*][p]Critical damage now has a + symbol to show it’s additional percentage.[/p][/*][*][p]Research lab UI art has been reworked slightly.[/p][/*][*][p]There is now a large text pop-up that appears when enemies gain strength as the run progresses.[/p][/*][*][p]The main menu has been reworked. Now the bottom menu bar will always be visible and makes it easier to quickly go between different menus.[/p][/*][*][p]New prompt on the cursor when using abilities or building structures which tells you which buttons will do what.[/p][/*][*][p]You can now view the enemies that exist in your current run in the upgrade menu.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h2][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/h2][list][*][p]Inferno Tower flame FX now scale correctly with increased range.[/p][/*][*][p]Hazards now correctly glow when selected like Towers and other structures.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Needler and Buzzer enemies attacking in melee range.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where 2x2 structures could not be placed on certain highground positions.[/p][/*][*][p]Particle effect when selling structures now scales with structure size.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where resource caches and alien ruins would not spawn on certain map seeds.[/p][/*][*][p]Mortar Tower barrel no longer starts parallel to the ground.[/p][/*][*][p]Speed stripes upgrade now correctly increases Enemy movement-speed.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Axom: Conquest Demo Patch v0.7.2.5
notes.content: [h3]Quality of Life Improvements[/h3][list][*][p]Sell value of structures is now visible in the sell button.[/p][/*][*][p]Clickable map rewards are now more obvious (sparkles are more eye-catching).[/p][/*][*][p]Cursor now glows continuously when Ion-Cannon is ready.[/p][/*][*][p]Health bars are now slightly more visible and contrasting.[/p][/*][*][p]Health bars now have a subtle grid pattern to improve readability.[/p][/*][*][p]Difficulty icon tooltip now shows current enemy health and damage modifiers (updates after each boss wave).[/p][/*][*][p]Added a few more tutorial hints.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3]Visual Improvements[/h3][list][*][p]Nexus-Drill landing sequence at the start of games is now faster and flashier.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3]Bug Fixes[/h3][list][*][p]Fixed a bug where structure health would heal slightly when loading a saved run.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where Swarmer Elites would not spawn correctly — they now appear as intended.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3]Balance Changes[/h3][p][b]Resources & Economy[/b][/p][list][*][p]Refinery base yield increased by 33%.[/p][/*][*][p]Nexus-Drill base yield increased by 25%.[/p][/*][*][p]Starting resources increased to 25 (from 18).[/p][/*][*][p]Scouting-Beacon upgrade cost reduced by 37.5%.[/p][/*][*][p]Hard difficulty now provides +50% research gained.[/p][/*][*][p]Structures on Normal difficulty now auto-repair 10% of base health at the end of each wave.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Enemy Scaling[/b][/p][list][*][p]Enemy health scaling increased by 15% every 5 waves.[/p][/*][*][p]Enemy damage scaling increased by 10% every 5 waves.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3]Structure Capacity Buffs[/h3][p][b]Towers[/b][/p][list][*][p]Blast-Tower: 2 → 4[/p][/*][*][p]Discharge-Turret: 3 → 5[/p][/*][*][p]Flak-Gun: 10 → 12[/p][/*][*][p]Inferno-Tower: 4 → 6[/p][/*][*][p]Laser-Tower: 4 → 6[/p][/*][*][p]Missile-Turret: 4 → 6[/p][/*][*][p]Rail-Gun: 2 → 4[/p][/*][*][p]Repair-Tower: 2 → 4[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Hazards[/b][/p][list][*][p]Land-Mine: 16 → 20[/p][/*][*][p]Radiation-Zone: 2 → 4[/p][/*][*][p]Shock-Floor: 4 → 6[/p][/*][*][p]Smart-Mine: 6 → 10[/p][/*][*][p]Spike-Floor: 6 → 8[/p][/*][*][p]Stasis-Trap: 2 → 4[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Modules[/b][/p][list][*][p]Razor-Whirler: 2 → 4[/p][/*][*][p]Booster-Module: 2 → 4[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3]Audio[/h3][list][*][p]Fire audio for fire ring upgrades is now quieter and less obnoxious.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Axom: Conquest Demo Patch 0.7.2.4
notes.content: [h3][b]Gameplay Balance[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]Knockback[/b]: Minor speed debuff duration reduced from [b]0.8s to 0.4s[/b].[/p][/*][*][p][b]Viewfinders (Basic Upgrade)[/b]: Vision bonus increased from [b]12% to 15%[/b].[/p][/*][*][p][b]Research-Lab[/b] and [b]Scrap-Yard[/b]: Now [b]increase tower/hazard capacity by +1 per upgrade level[/b], replacing their previous damage-only effect.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Trader Pricing[/b]: Already owned upgrades now [b]cost more per rank[/b].[/p][/*][*][p][b]Ore Patches[/b]: Maximum number of [b]Refined Metal Ore[/b] patches increased from [b]8 to 10[/b].[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3][b]Map Generation[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]Cliffs and Canyons[/b]: Minimum distance to the [b]Nexus-Drill[/b] reduced by [b]18%[/b], increasing the number of choke points and nearby terrain features.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Fixed [b]knockback[/b] causing enemies to be pushed into the ground while continuing to attack.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed [b]Scrap-Yard[/b] passive and ability not functioning correctly.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed issue where the [b]build menu and upgrade display[/b] would resize due to large tooltips.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed issue preventing [b]Refinery placement[/b] near cliffs or canyons.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3][b]User Interface & Visual Feedback[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]Resolution setting[/b] is now disabled when using [b]Windowed Fullscreen[/b] mode.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Tower targeting types[/b] (Air-only, Ground-only, etc.) are now more clearly described.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Structures destroyed by infection[/b] now display a [b]unique icon[/b].[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3][b]Audio[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Added a new [b]voice line[/b] for when [b]Refineries[/b] are destroyed by infection.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: June Update - Demo Patch 1
notes.content: [p][i]We've been hard at work covering every single piece of feedback from the demo and implementing into this patch.[/i][/p][p][i]This has a few sweeping changes such as the removal of ramps to create more chokepoints (Which seems right for a tower defence game)[/i][/p][p][i]We would love to hear your thoughts on what can be changed or improved even more.[/i][/p][p][i]Thank you![/i][/p][p][/p][h2]UI Improvements[/h2][list][*][p][b]Upgrade and Building Text[/b][/p][list][*][p]Increased size for easier readability[/p][/*][*][p]Tooltip text now scales dynamically[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Tooltips[/b][/p][list][*][p]Abilities now show their base cooldowns[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Scrap Button[/b][/p][list][*][p]Reduced in size to prevent missclicks[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Structure Alerts[/b][/p][list][*][p]New 2D visuals indicate when structures are destroyed, including off-screen alerts[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Endgame Screen[/b][/p][list][*][p]Now includes a screenshot of your final base layout[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Animations & Feedback[/b][/p][list][*][p]UI animations are smoother[/p][/*][*][p]New visual cues when actions can't be performed[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Damage Numbers[/b][/p][list][*][p]Improved appearance and proper resolution scaling[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Cursor[/b][/p][list][*][p]Now glows pink when the Ion Cannon is ready[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Boss Icon[/b][/p][list][*][p]Updated to match current visual style[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Menus & Settings[/b][/p][list][*][p]Main menu buttons enlarged[/p][/*][*][p]Added setting to simplify UI shaders[/p][/*][*][p]Added extra loading screen hints[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h2]Gameplay Changes[/h2][list][*][p][b]Major Terrain Update[/b][/p][list][*][p]Ramps removed: Enemies only spawn on ground level[/p][/*][*][p]High ground is now a safe zone for building[/p][/*][*][p]Goal: Make chokepoint defense more viable[/p][/*][*][p][b]Feedback encouraged on this change[/b][/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Scouting Beacon[/b][/p][list][*][p]Removed from the build list[/p][/*][*][p]Now a free ability usable once per wave[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Map Interaction[/b][/p][list][*][p]Added clickable blue crystals for small Refined Metal + Research gain[/p][/*][*][p]Encourages exploration during build phase[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Map Generation[/b][/p][list][*][p]More alleyways and terrain variety added[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced large flat areas[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Tutorial Option[/b][/p][list][*][p]Checkbox added to New Game menu to replay tutorial[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Building Tweaks[/b][/p][list][*][p]Steel Walls: Health increased (100 → 110)[/p][/*][*][p]Refineries:[/p][list][*][p]Base cap reduced (4 → 2)[/p][/*][*][p]Base yield increased (10 → 12)[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Brood Worm spawner count reduced in early waves[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h2]Enemy Balance & Damage Scaling[/h2][list][*][p][b]Early Game Adjustments[/b][/p][list][*][p]Swarmer Elites now spawn from Wave 4 (was Wave 1)[/p][/*][*][p]Swarmer base damage reduced by 10%[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Late Game Scaling[/b][/p][list][*][p]Enemy tier damage multiplier increased by 5%[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][quote][p]Early waves should feel less punishing, while late waves remain a challenge.[/p][/quote][hr][/hr][h2]Upgrades[/h2][list][*][p][b]New Additions[/b][/p][list][*][p]New upgrades have been added to be discovered[/p][/*][*][p]New basic upgrade: +1 Refinery Capacity[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Balance Changes[/b][/p][list][*][p]Space Stilts: High ground bonus reduced (80% → 60%)[/p][/*][*][p]Discount Coupon: Cost penalty increased (10% → 12%)[/p][/*][*][p]Survival Nexus: Shop price penalty increased (75% → 80%)[/p][/*][*][p]Axomite Shard: Refinery yield bonus increased (20% → 30%)[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h2]Visual Enhancements[/h2][list][*][p][b]Cliffs[/b][/p][list][*][p]Level 2 unbuildable cliffs now appear darker (especially in snowy biome)[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Path Preview[/b][/p][list][*][p]Enemy spawn paths now visible during build phase[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Grid Highlighting[/b][/p][list][*][p]High ground build tiles now glow light blue[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]FX Certain sounds ignoring volume settings[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed: Construction sound now modulates correctly[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed: Brood Worms spawning on boss eggs[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed: Reduced-cost buildings now sell for less as expected[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed: Music no longer resets after muting[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed: Flying bosses no longer produce footstep sounds[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed: Delay in tower notes.title: Axom: Conquest May Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45289121/9cf29f2c1c2ca50198f875fb198ebe9645e15d97.png[/img]

We're happy to announce that the new amazing demo is coming out this month, with a whole shedload of new features and cool stuff. Look out for it soon!

[h1]Don't Step on the Sand![/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45289121/ffaa7d6f2568e8dda40a8d4d12df7624b0f2b1bf.gif[/img]

One of the new things in Axom: Conquest this month is this horrible fellow which the science team has dubbed the "Brood Worm"
While looking horrifying it serves a dual purpose in that it is the source of the enemies you fight but also gives a thematic reason for being there.
It also allows players to see and plan ahead of the Centurax's assault.

[h1]User Interface Overhaul and quality of life[/h1]

A couple of requested quality of life features this month, firstly to address "I'd like to see the range of the towers before I place them"
Well, Tada!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45289121/be54076625cd8f0f75ed96c56992a52c55bf46ce.gif[/img]

The other requested feature was "Ah I can't drag to place walls but that's ok"
No it's not! And we made it happen!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45289121/a3ec25e4cccf788fe1c3d6ac4c73adc6820c912f.gif[/img]

You can now drag to place walls in any direction and it will automatically update in real time.

[h3]General UI[/h3]
The general interface during play has been made slicker and more polished.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45289121/52ff34150933203958d63039a60dc927f367c750.jpg[/img]

[h3]Upgrade List[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45289121/38f3193bbe531a0d90da3e64f656da7a020fdbf7.jpg[/img]

Since you're bound to get dozens and dozens of upgrades during a run, there needs to be a place to remember everything you've gotten. Now there is a dedicated menu which shows all the upgrades you've gotten during a run and a tooltip to show what they do even if you forget!

[h2]Mutations[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45289121/50dd4c0cb70e4d1d937092ce4f6883f4a7800ec4.jpg[/img]

Mutations are a new feature on harder difficulties that give negative bonuses every so many waves depending on difficulty. They are designed to make to have to think on the fly and potentially rework your strategy.
And If you don't like them they do not appear on normal difficulty.

[h2]New "New game screen"[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45289121/10f9bfaf1e3b12dfbf828293a6f7db2838e6560c.jpg[/img]

Because of the new implementation of difficulties you now need a place to select this. There is now a new game screen where you can select difficulty but also your Nexus Type!

[h3]Nexus Type[/h3]
Nexus types are unlockable content that change your run in a small but meaningful way. You start with the Green Nexus which gives a health bonus but there will be many more to unlock. How about one that Reverses all your currencies or one that randomises all building costs!

[h1]Other Changes[/h1]

[list]
[*]All Upgrades have been made stronger to make them more impactful, but enemies are now stronger too!
[*]The first trader now only gives common upgrades so they are all affordable
[*]Added a new gameplay option which is on by default. The camera will now automatically pan to destroyed structures to make it easier to defend
[*] Certain buildings are now quicker to access during a run and will appear sooner
[/list]

notes.title: Axom: Conquest April Update
notes.content:
[h1]Boss Eggs[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45289121/22d6578c42b685029f410fc157edc85bb6935edf.gif[/img]

Over April a lot of new things have been introduced to the game in the name of making the game as fun as it can possibly be. One of these new features is the boss egg.

Originally bosses would spawn randomly every so many waves which was ok but didn't invoke enough strategic thinking from players. Now every set amount of waves a boss egg will spawn somewhere on the map, it's not hard to find but will give players ample time to plan their defence while they watch it pulsate and grow, spreading infection as it does!

Which ties into the next thing introduced in this April development update.

[h1]Tile Modifiers[/h1]

Another thing added is tile modifiers, this was a big system to implement and allows any tile on the map to have a certain type. For now there are two types, Infection and Void but more will be added during development

[h2]Infection[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45289121/db0c7e72fd57dd732d9de3006608bf1cc812dc48.gif[/img]

Infection spawns from boss eggs as well as various other alien mechanics such as worm spawners. Infection serves as an lethal force that spreads around the map during a run, forcing players to adapt their defences on the fly. It was introduced as a way to prevent runs from becoming stale after defences had been set up. Don't worry however, there are many upgrades which interact with this mechanic, one such one is an alien building enhancement which allows you to build on infected ground and even provides a boost.

[h2]Void[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45289121/e674ca8e31e9d7568abf19d19d55eba7b385efae.gif[/img]

Void ground can appear from upgrades and provides building with a significant boost to power while they're inside, but beware as sometimes the void likes to consume these buildings too!

[h1]New Upgrades[/h1]
One of the pillars of Axom: Conquest is creating the tools for players to forge their own creative builds while creating strategic depth which means every run looks and plays different. 

For example, imagine one run you have no walls and all your towers can be phased through, meaning you can put all your resources into damage. While another you might be placing buildings away from the action intestinally as they increase in strength when not attacking.

Here is an example of a strategic upgrade and another simply fun one!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45289121/8bde1d66be6fb895f3a0ad0a01a74e035d2be550.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45289121/847325ca4f37b40ff4b3a53ae4e653076396ae72.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45289121/35eaca89565e96e2b096ef4898c37eb01f7a0976.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45289121/afe4488c231f28af26567bff0a5e811c065a2672.gif[/img]

[h2]Quality of life and balance[/h2]
I'm dedicated to making sure Axom: Conquest is the best possible game it can be and I am always changing things to make them ever so slightly better. Here is a couple

[list]
[*]New voice line for when refineries are destroyed
[*]Land Mines now return at the end of each wave, rather than being one time use
[*]Quick restart button added to the menu and defeat screens
[*]You can now press escape to quickly get out of menus
[/list]

notes.title: Axom: Conquest March Update
notes.content:
[h1]Demo Feedback[/h1]

Thank you to all those who played the Demo during next-fest, we have received some great feedback that helps shape Axom: Conquest into the best game it can possibly be.

One of the biggest things changed this month is an overhaul of the entire upgrade system. Originally all upgrades were part of the same pool. However a lot of these upgrades were deemed boring or there was no thinking involved in the choice you have.

In order to address this, upgrades are now split into four categories.

[h3]Basic[/h3]
Basic upgrades are you run of the mill stat upgrades, however they now appear at the end of every wave and give a guaranteed way to progress over the course of the game while still giving choice of which stats you want.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45289121/364cbe38d3aa7e8a55f83d1ba1b854c571aedb1c.jpg[/img]

[h3]Nexus[/h3]
Nexus upgrades are now where the real hard choices are. These are the upgrades that you can choose from every few waves and have a lot of impact. New buildings and build defining upgrades are found here.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45289121/55871f261e6a804da16ee282001a938f992b1122.jpg[/img]

[h3]Trader[/h3]
Trader upgrades contain the bulk of the upgrades now, these are ones that you buy using the currency gained from slaying bugs! All of these upgrades have been rethought over and made a lot more interesting with pros and cons and make you think about what you're buying.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45289121/91819e55fd637e1f78dde34d4da965c3f1cd50d6.jpg[/img]

[h3]Alien[/h3]
Alien upgrades are found from bosses and from exploring the map. These upgrades tend to be wildcards, very rarely giving raw power and instead giving weird effects and harnessing the alien nature of the planet.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45289121/b1f29b01be903e99a4bbd9023e208d281086de44.jpg[/img]


[h1]Instant Building[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45289121/d13f5fbeed04b21e21b088b0e433a679327c3263.gif[/img]

Another thing mentioned in feedback was how building feels a bit sluggish, while the initial intent was to provide a meaningful risk/reward in having to plan ahead and build your base carefully, overall it felt a bit too punishing. After playtesting the removal of construction time, the game now feels a lot snappier and more engaging to play.
One of the best parts of this is that as soon as you unlock a new building you can build it immediately and utilize it straight away!

[h2]Better Tooltips[/h2]

Tooltips are now a lot more legible, all relevant information is now colour coded and text is more concise

[h2]Worm spawners[/h2]

Another balance change is the introduction of worm spawners. These are spawn points for enemies that appear in random locations at the start of the wave. Originally enemies would spawn from the edges of the map in static locations, while this provided good gameplay for the initial waves it eventually led to a point in the game where enemies would be coming from only certain locations and it let to stale runs where nothing happened.
With the worm spawners this means now that after a certain time in a run, enemies can potentially come from any direction. This means you will always need to be protecting different parts of your base from attack.

[h3]Enemy giblets![/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45289121/1ff2caaaf6dfa4ed03f1073d69f44b0421647fa2.gif[/img]

Enemies now explode into meaty chunks to make it even more satisfying

[list]
[*] The maximum zoom distance has been increased, this gives you a better overall view of the battlefield, while still allowing you to get up close and personal to the action.

[*] Enemy pathing is now more accurate, enemies are less likely to path in weird directions but they will still sometimes take a different path so watch out for stray enemies!

[*] Maps are now more randomised! During the demo the maps, while random were all generated using the same generation math, this meant they all looked quite similar. Now there is many more factors that go into the randomisation, including the amount of canyons, the size of canyons, the general scale of the hills and cliffs (Meaning it can be more smooth or rough)
[/list]

notes.title: Axom: Conquest February Update
notes.content:
We're gearing up for Next Fest so the biggest thing this month is of course the Demo!

[h1]Demo Coming February 24th![/h1]

The demo will contain the first 30 waves and the first 4 tiers of research for you to experiment with!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45289121/3ca0e325cd3cfef0461ce4c6c79724bec03a373b.png[/img]

[h1]Living up to the Roguelike name[/h1]

Axom: Conquest now contains dozens of random upgrades you can find or research. More are being added every week!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45289121/563abfd29b6180ddec291019731d1fda5d8b5f72.png[/img]

[h1]Space Trader[/h1]

One of the best ways to obtain extra upgrades is through the trader who will drop in every few waves to offer you valuable random upgrades.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45289121/3af4f99e27eda7d13933414af785e403dfe4b5d2.png[/img]

[h1]Hidden Caches![/h1]

One of the biggest parts of Axom: Conquest is the exploration, hidden caches are scattered around the map from previous miners who fell to the Centurax. Uncover the darkness to discover the hidden treasures.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45289121/50298381a1fd7282e86f3cb8a77a842cb66cdd4e.png[/img]

[h2]Other cools things[/h2]

[list]
[*]Combat Music is now a thing!
[*]Improved sound effects
[*]A full on settings menu with various accessibility options
[/list]

We hope you look forward to the Demo and enjoy it as much as I've enjoyed making it!

notes.title: Axom: Conquest January Update
notes.content:
There’s been a lot of improvements over the last couple months! 
Here’s what’s new:

[h2]Dozens of New Upgrades[/h2]
We’ve added tons more upgrades for you to unlock and experiment with. Your towers are going to feel more powerful than ever!

[h2]Main Menu Overhaul[/h2]
The main menu got a big redesign. It’s way easier to use now, and it looks much cooler too.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45289121/f5ba6a84627682858b8fc16e167dc092ec7338b5.jpg[/img]

[h2]Ion Cannon Rework[/h2]
The Ion Cannon has been changed. It now has a wind-up time before firing, but when it does, it creates a massive AoE explosion. Super satisfying to use!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45289121/11f760a0eca5f0cbae7b913123d3b2c47d7140b0.jpg[/img]

[h2]Damage Numbers[/h2]
You can now see damage numbers when you hit enemies! It’s a small thing, but it feels great to watch those numbers pop up as your towers shred bugs.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45289121/74d0ee571eb7455a607f718ac99fd503676e23b2.jpg[/img]

There's also been dozens of bugs squashed, ant not the alien kind! Fixes and other tweaks to make things run smoother.

More updates are on the way, so stay tuned!
